summary.text: Yusuf Yusuf is a Democratic state representative who has represented Maine House District 118 since December 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Born in Mogadishu, Somalia, he has worked as a small business owner, educator, mental health case manager and community advocate.

paragraphs.text: Yusuf was born in Mogadishu, Somalia, and earned a bachelor's degree from Western Washington University in 2016.
His career experience includes working as a small business owner, educator, mental health case manager and community advocate.
Ballotpedia lists a prior office for Yusuf as an at-large seat with Portland Public Schools.
He took office in the Maine House on December 3, 2024, succeeding Rachel Talbot Ross, and advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
